cases.scene: Ernst, Johnny and Johan are assigned to investigate a dangerous unfamiliar artifact. Ernst insists on personally testing it despite warnings and offered protection, seeking to understand the strange mechanism. Johnny expresses fear and refuses to proceed without protective measures and support from allies. Johan voluntarily rejects an offered translation shortcut, meticulously verifying each line despite the delay; the scene does not establish his threat sensitivity.
cases.perspective: Ernst considers only his own stated response in this scene.
cases.review_note: Illustrative characters, not actual recorded behavior. Participation supplies no automatic curiosity; do not transfer another character's action.
